analyst.summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure (DIACABS) makes power transmission and distribution equipment and has shown very high reported revenue growth recently - growth that looks like recovery from a previously distressed position rather than steady demand growth, based on a highly unusual ownership history and an extraordinary long-term stock move. The company's own auditor flagged a qualified opinion on fixed-asset records, net worth was still negative as of the last balance sheet date, and debt rose more than 5x in a year - though a large recent share sale (with credible institutional buyers) is earmarked to pay that debt down. We rate it a Hold per the quant score, but flag this as a genuine special situation warranting the portfolio manager's own review.
